links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Kincaid, SMOG) of chatbot patient education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT-5.2 Plus generated more readable responses, whereas Gemini and DeepSeek V3.2 required higher reading grade levels.
links.quote: Readability analysis indicated that ChatGPT-5.2 Plus generated more readable responses, whereas Gemini and DeepSeek V3.2 required higher reading grade levels.

links.outcome: Consistency (coefficient of variation) of repeated chatbot responses across times and days
links.effect: Consistency scores differed significantly among models (p < 0.05), with Gemini 3 Plus and DeepSeek V3.2 more consistent than ChatGPT-5.2; accuracy was higher on day 2 (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Consistency scores differed significantly among models (p < 0.05), with Gemini 3 Plus and DeepSeek V3.2 showing higher consistency than ChatGPT-5.2.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the accuracy, consistency, and readability of several LLM chatbots responding to patient questions about broken endodontic instruments without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
